tool_args.rationale: All five paid observations are positive and have H ≤ 0.48. The slow-horizon probe measures the response near the forecast horizon, where the candidate mechanisms can disagree even if they fit the short-window data equally well.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Over the short pilot window, slow adaptation is observed mainly through the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Near-equivalent pilot fits can therefore predict different outcomes at H = 23.3.
Denser early-time sampling is less informative than a long-horizon observation about whether and when adaptation reverses the positive response.
